scope: Metadata correction only; frozen fitter, protocol, maps, metrics, and original receipt remain unchanged.
corrected_statement: One physical-chip address template is replicated across 16 distinct chips. Each chip holds a distinct 176-row shard for each routed GU expert and a distinct 352-row shard for the shared GU. All coefficients are W8 and activations A8. C=2048, so each 16384-byte page contains eight complete output rows. No coefficient copy is introduced.
row_assignment: For chip c, owner-local page j covers original output rows c*owner_rows_per_chip+8*j through c*owner_rows_per_chip+8*j+7. Physical placement may reorder whole pages; fixed source order 0123 remains row safe because every page contains complete C2048 dots and output identities are scattered to their original rows.
RR_label_scope: flat_global_RR preserves the standard global RR block/plane assignment. Its materialized ledger uses equivalent compact per-plane word-line addresses and owner-local whole-row page ordering; numerical row identities are explicit. Under the assumed skip-WL geometry, this changes neither resident capacity nor useful read count nor wave count. It is not a claim that the original natural logical-row order is preserved.
timing_effect: None. This screen does not simulate finite PB/ECC execution or complete native timing.
